scope: development benchmark and executable baseline audit; no confirmation claim

strata.old_lineage: target >= 3 and at least 25% of retained events produced at target-2 or earlier in the common native lineage
strata.mixed: at least 3 producer versions in the common native retained history
strata.rare_activity: prior14day write_count or time_since_last_event strictly outside target-specific calibration512 1st/99th percentiles
strata.challenge: union of short, old_lineage, mixed, rare_activity
strata.routine: complement of challenge; background workload, not a safety label

denominator: same natural workload, four-release cache-only dependency-closed Exact-All; include D1 and D2 all preparations and actual incremental service calls once
reference_split: FreshCurrent at decision/diagnostic checkpoints for compatibility; release Exact-All plus independent native append for lifecycle quality. Never substitute the latter for FreshCurrent.
prospective_mechanism_workloads: all natural challenge strata and routine control
real retained suffix policies 32/128/1024 fixed from common M0 and maintained throughout each separate replay
native lineage snapshots after actual writes 0/1/128/1024/6144 when available; missing exposure stays missing
limits: Proposed engineering acceptance goals, not a scientific guarantee and not retroactively preregistered for old results. No threshold/group/UID tuning for passing this benchmark. No future labels in cohort assignment or scheduling. Original512/1024 and all frozen detector parameters unchanged.
